description: This is a test source file for the BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsData class in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for methods related to setting and getting form field namespace and path, as well as input validation.

classes.name: BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsDataTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing methods of BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsData, specifically for setting and retrieving form field namespace and path, with validation.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldSetTheUnderlyingFormNamespaceAndPathInTheCorrectPattern
methods.description: Tests that setFormField correctly sets the formNamespaceAndPath property with the expected pattern.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace_shouldReturnNullIfTheNamespaceIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Verifies getFormFieldNamespace returns null when namespace is an empty string.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace_shouldReturnTheCorrectNamespaceForAFormFieldWithAPath
methods.description: Checks that getFormFieldNamespace returns the correct namespace when set.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace_shouldReturnTheNamespaceForAFormFieldThatHasNoPath
methods.description: Checks that getFormFieldNamespace returns the namespace even when the path is null.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath_shouldReturnNullIfThePathIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Verifies getFormFieldPath returns null when path is an empty string.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath_shouldReturnTheCorrectPathForAFormFieldWithANamespace
methods.description: Checks that getFormFieldPath returns the correct path when set.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath_shouldReturnThePathForAFormFieldThatHasNoNamespace
methods.description: Ensures getFormFieldPath returns the path even when namespace is empty.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldRejectANamepaceAndPathCombinationLongerThanTheMaxLength
methods.description: Validates that setFormField throws an APIException when namespace length exceeds 255 characters.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldRejectANamepaceContainingTheSeparator
methods.description: Validates that setFormField throws an APIException when namespace contains the separator character.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldRejectAPathContainingTheSeparator
methods.description: Validates that setFormField throws an APIException when path contains the separator character.
